title: Make Zero
source_text: You are given an array $A$ of $N$ integers with $1 \le A_i \le N$. You can perform $2$ types of operations: - Select an integer $X$ ($1 \le X \le N$) and update $A_i = |A_i - X|$ for all $1 \le i \le N$. This has a cost of $0$. - Select an integer $X$ ($2 \le X \le N$) and update $A_i = A_i \mod X$ for all $1 \le i \le N$. This has a cost of $1$. Find the minimum total cost to convert the array $A$ into all $0$s. Further, find a sequence of operations of length at most $15$ which achieves it. Input - The first line of input will contain a single integer $T$, denoting the number of test cases. - Each test case consists of multiple lines of input. - The first line contains a single integer $N$ - the size of the array. - The second line contains $N$ integers - $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_N$. Output For each test case, output the following: - On the first line, output the minimum cost - Then on the second line, output the number of operations, say $K$. ($1 \le K \le 15$) - Then, each of the next $K$ lines should be $2$ integers - $ty$ and $X$. ($1 \le ty \le 2$) - You should guarantee $1 \le X \le N$ if $ty = 1$, and $2 \le X \le N$ if $ty = 2$. - $ty = 1$ if you are choosing the first operation, and $ty = 2$ for the second operation; $X$ corresponds to the chosen parameter. Constraints - $1 \le T \le 100$ - $3 \le N \le 1000$ - $1 \le A_i \le N$ Sample Input 2 3 1 3 3 3 2 2 3 Sample Output 0 2 1 2 1 1 1 3 2 3 1 1 1 1
